title: qa(checklist): clauses for three round-3 defects outside the ledger, plus two RUNNER rules — a pin scores only the layer it drives, and an off-clause probe budget
body:
Fixes #24802
Clause-②: no — the internal QA ledger and its runner protocol; nothing published

## Summary

Three ledger clauses for the defects round 3 of the 18.0 sweep found outside the ledger, and two RUNNER rules. Each new clause carries a `QA-source:` citation, a `revision` bump, a `history` row, and a `knownGaps` line naming its card. Each stays red until that card's fix lands.

- **`api-backend.batch-transactional-discovery` rev 6 (#24781).** New acceptance[5]: an `update` or `delete` op on `POST /api/v1/batch` whose id is the empty string answers 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, the same as a missing id, and never a 5xx. Adds steps[6] (the empty-id pair plus their no-id controls) and negative[1]. Source: QA run #24779, observed beside the clauses.
- **`records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix` rev 5 (#24782).** New acceptance[5] (log oracle): an unevaluable `severity: 'warning'` rule lets the write land, and no log entry naming the rule says the write was rejected or failed closed. fixtures.requires[2] carries round 3's recipe: two scratch objects authored through `PUT /api/v1/meta/object`, each with a script rule `int(record.title) > 1`, one at `warning` and one at `error`. That closes round 2's fixture gap (QA run #24616: negative[0] blocked(fixture), "an unevaluable CEL validation cannot be authored through any door"). negative[0] now names its scratch object. Adds steps[6] and negative[3].
- **`access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` rev 6 (#24784).** New acceptance[7], the walled `group` leg: a member whose membership set is non-empty and whose session has no active organization never gets a 5xx on a tenant-scoped create, and nothing is stamped with a NULL `organization_id`. Whether `group` lands that write or refuses it 4xx is left to #24784. Adds steps[8] (the set-active-null producer) and knownGaps[3]. `automated.ref` now names the layer its pin drives. `no-active-organization-write-refusal.test.ts` runs SecurityPlugin's middleware over a stub terminal that stands in for the engine, so its `group` CONTROL "lands" at the plugin-security layer only. The pin therefore cannot score acceptance[7].
- **RUNNER rule 6, new paragraph: a pin scores only the layer it drives.** Before a pin scores a clause whose oracle is a public door's answer, the runner names the layer the pin reaches (plugin unit, engine, or HTTP), read off the pin's harness. A pin that stops above the oracle's layer scores the clause `partial` and names the missing layer. #24784 is the worked instance. The paragraph sits beside rule 6, not inside the walled-boot entry.
- **RUNNER rule 8: keep an off-clause probe budget.** Each run keeps time after its clauses for probing the selector's doors past them: boundary values, the opposite severity or posture, and recipients outside the asserted scope. A probe scores nothing. A finding that passes the filing gate is extracted with `QA-source: … · observed beside the clauses`. The run-record body contract gains the probe line: how long the probes took, what they covered, and what they found.

**Not in this PR: the `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` clause for #24785.** Its fix PR #24794 is still an open draft (checked just before this PR was opened). Under RUNNER rule 2 that clause would publish the reproduction before the fix ships, so it waits until #24794 merges.

Out of scope, and not touched here: the round-3 re-points and accuracy findings in #24579 comment 6284472874. These include F3, the `group` wording of this item's acceptance[0] and [1] and its knownGaps[0] and [1] producers. They belong to the anchor lane.

## Verification

The clauses were run on a stock showcase at `a43405d596`, this branch's base and current `origin/main`. The build was `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (76/76). The boot was `objectstack dev --seed-admin`, posture `single`, on a fresh DB. Server stopped by process group afterwards.

| clause | expected now (card open) | measured |
|---|---|---|
| batch acceptance[5], update with id empty string | red | 500 `DATABASE_ERROR` "Internal data error"; no-id control 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` "Operation 'update' on 'showcase_task' requires an id" |
| batch acceptance[5], delete with id empty string | red | 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR`; no-id control 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`. Log: `[REST] Unhandled error: Error: Update requires an ID or options.multi=true` (and the Delete twin) |
| validation acceptance[5], warning rule | red | 201, row persisted (re-read 1 row). The log prints two entries naming `qa_unevaluable_warn`, and both say "write rejected". The first ends "a rule that cannot be evaluated fails closed, it is never skipped" after a multi-line CEL caret excerpt, so the verify text now says to read each entry to its end |
| validation negative[0], error twin | green | 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, fields[0] `{field: _record, code: rule_violation}`, re-read 0 rows |
| no-active-org acceptance[7], walled group | red | not measured here: it needs a walled boot (scratch app declaring `@objectstack/organizations`, owner email, membership policy). Its red rests on QA run #24783 and the RUNNER rule 7 re-derivation in #24784. Per the dispatch, written from knownGaps, not hand-tested |

The red and green states match the cards: #24781, #24782 and #24784 are open.

## Acceptance notes

- Steps are referenced 1-based in `verify` text, as the existing api-backend clauses do ("step-7"). History rows use 0-based array indices ("steps[6]").
- The batch and validation knownGaps lines record the `580fd4ed` measurement and this PR's re-measurement at `a43405d596`. Each tells the runner to re-run the clause and drop the line once its card's fix merges.
